demo_must_show: OAuth consent flow for Locality with all visible requested permissions expanded and readable.
Selecting only Google Docs that Locality created or that the user explicitly granted through Google Picker, then mounting that selected set.
Opening a selected Google Doc in Locality to show its body is read through the Google Docs API.
Editing a selected Google Doc body from Locality and showing the changed content in the user's Google Docs account.
Creating a Google Doc within the selected set and showing its new body content in the user's Google Docs account.
least_privilege_notes: documents is required because Locality reads Google Docs body content and applies body edits through the Google Docs API.
drive.file is required because Locality creates Google Docs and mutates app-created or explicitly granted Drive files for rename, move, and trash workflows.
drive.metadata is not requested because writable Drive metadata access beyond app-created or explicitly granted files is not needed; app-file writes are covered by drive.file.
Full Drive, Drive readonly, and Docs readonly scopes are not requested by the runtime OAuth profile and must not be submitted for Google Docs verification.
